name: Nagachika Hideyoshi
source:
Nagachika Hideyoshi is a normal human and the best friend of [url=/c34996]Kaneki Ken[/url]. He attends Kamii University. While there, he was studying Foreign Language Studies — majoring in English — at the Department of International Studies.

At a certain point, he started working part-time at the CCG, and soon became an investigation assistant helping both Koutarou Amon and Akira Mado.

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Hideyoshi_Nagachika#Post-Aogiri%E2%96%BE]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
